acceptance: Red test first: a faketmux REPL that ignores Enter for 20 s after the paste and then accepts it ends submitted_after_resend (today: submit_wedged).
A table test pins the verifySubmitted resend schedule from config.
A live bridge run of 4 concurrent claude seats with a 55 KB prompt submits 4/4, three times in a row.
Docs in STE: the bridge package note records the readiness and resend rules, with the evidence.
fix: Readiness is the first render of the prompt marker, and the Enter resends stop about 11 s after the paste (gaps 0.5/1.5/2.5 s). (1) Judge submission on a positive signal (the history/paste-cache entry, or the composer leaving '[Pasted text'). (2) Resend on a deadline schedule of about 2, 5, 10, 20, 30 s, set in config. (3) Before the paste, wait for an idle pane (unchanged for at least 1 s after the marker). (4) Stagger concurrent claude-tmux boots or gate them with a boot semaphore. First prove whether a late Enter submits: rebuild with longer gaps and a pane dump per resend, launch 4 at once.
notes: Console route: bridge prompt delivery. Investigation 2026-11-02 (subagent, 8 live runs). Related public reports: claudeissues #52812 (tmux submit ignored), crow PR #274 (paste-buffer/Enter race).
summary: claude-tmux leaves a bracketed paste unsubmitted when seats boot together: reproduced through the bridge 3/4 wedged with 4 concurrent launches, 0/4 sequential (55 KB prompt). Not new in 2.1.316 and not size- or phase-specific: prompt-site resends rose from 3/430 (2.1.303-305) to 59 resends + 2 wedges /412 (2.1.311) and 11 + 4 /179 (2.1.316); routers wedge too. Claude never accepted the Enter (no ~/.claude/history.jsonl or paste-cache entry for wedged sessions).
title: A pasted prompt submits reliably when several claude seats boot at the same moment
